fullContentHtml:
AIIMS NORCET 11th Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : All India Institute of Medical Science AIIMS has released the Admit Card for the Nursing Officer Common Eligibility Test 2026 (NORCET-11th) on its official website. This recruitment was released for 2218 posts. Applications for AIIMS NORCET 11th Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 24 July 2026 to 13 August 2026. The Stage – I examination is going to be conducted  on 12 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their AIIMS NORCET 11th Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 24 July 2026
  • Last Date : 13 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : August 2026
  • Stage-I Exam Date : 12 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 03 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 09 September 2026
  • Stage-II Exam Date : 30 September 2026
  • Result : Will be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 3000/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 2400/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

AIIMS NORCET 11th Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 13 August 2026.

The official website is: https://www.aiimsexams.ac.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
